<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<interface>
  <template class="AddPdfDialog" parent="AdwDialog">
    <property name="width-request">360</property>
    <property name="height-request">270</property>
    <property name="content-width">450</property>
    <property name="content-height">270</property>
    <property name="title" translatable="yes">Add PDF</property>
    <property name="focus-widget">pdf_url_entry_row</property>
    <child>
      <object class="AdwToolbarView">
        <child type="top">
          <object class="AdwHeaderBar"/>
        </child>
        <child>
          <object class="AdwToastOverlay" id="toast_overlay">
            <child>
              <object class="GtkOverlay">
                <child type="overlay">
                  <object class="GtkProgressBar" id="progress_bar">
                    <property name="valign">start</property>
                    <property name="visible">False</property>
                    <style>
                      <class name="osd"/>
                    </style>
                  </object>
                </child>
                <child>
                  <object class="GtkScrolledWindow">
                    <child>
                      <object class="AdwClamp">
                        <property name="vexpand">True</property>
                        <child>
                          <object class="GtkBox">
                            <property name="orientation">vertical</property>
                            <property name="margin-top">24</property>
                            <property name="margin-bottom">24</property>
                            <property name="margin-start">12</property>
                            <property name="margin-end">12</property>
                            <property name="spacing">12</property>
                            <child>
                              <object class="GtkBox" id="error_box">
                                <property name="visible">False</property>
                                <child>
                                  <object class="GtkLabel">
                                    <property name="xalign">0</property>
                                    <property name="label" translatable="yes">Bibliography folder not set</property>
                                    <style>
                                      <class name="error"/>
                                    </style>
                                  </object>
                                </child>
                                <child>
                                  <object class="GtkLabel" id="error_label">
                                    <property name="xalign">0</property>
                                    <style>
                                      <class name="error"/>
                                    </style>
                                  </object>
                                </child>
                              </object>
                            </child>
                            <child>
                              <object class="GtkLabel">
                                <property name="label" translatable="yes">Creates a copy of the selected pdf and stores it in your Bibliography folder.</property>
                                <property name="wrap-mode">word-char</property>
                                <property name="wrap">True</property>
                                <property name="xalign">0</property>
                                <style>
                                  <class name="dimmed"/>
                                </style>
                              </object>
                            </child>
                            <child>
                              <object class="GtkListBox">
                                <property name="selection-mode">none</property>
                                <child>
                                  <object class="AdwEntryRow" id="pdf_url_entry_row">
                                    <property name="activatable">True</property>
                                    <property name="title" translatable="yes">Add From URL</property>
                                    <signal name="entry-activated" handler="on_entry_activated" swapped="true"/>
                                    <child>
                                      <object class="GtkButton" id="download_button">
                                        <property name="valign">center</property>
                                        <property name="icon-name">go-next-symbolic</property>
                                        <property name="tooltip-text" translatable="yes">Download…</property>
                                        <signal name="clicked" handler="on_download_pdf_button_clicked" swapped="true"/>
                                        <style>
                                          <class name="flat"/>
                                        </style>
                                      </object>
                                    </child>
                                  </object>
                                </child>
                                <child>
                                  <object class="AdwButtonRow">
                                    <property name="activatable">True</property>
                                    <property name="title" translatable="yes">Add From File…</property>
                                    <property name="start-icon-name">document-open-symbolic</property>
                                    <signal name="activated" handler="set_from_file_row_activated" swapped="yes"/>
                                  </object>
                                </child>
                                <style>
                                  <class name="boxed-list-separate"/>
                                </style>
                              </object>
                            </child>
                          </object>
                        </child>
                      </object>
                    </child>
                  </object>
                </child>
              </object>
            </child>
          </object>
        </child>
      </object>
    </child>
  </template>
</interface>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<interface>
  <template class="CitationPreview" parent="AdwBin">
    <signal name="notify::template" handler="on_template_notify" swapped="true"/>
    <child>
      <object class="GtkBox">
        <property name="orientation">vertical</property>
        <property name="spacing">6</property>
        <child>
          <object class="GtkRevealer" id="template_revealer">
            <property name="reveal-child">False</property>
            <property name="transition-type">slide-up</property>
            <child>
              <object class="AdwPreferencesGroup" id="citation_fmt_group">
                <property name="title" translatable="yes">Custom Citation Format</property>
                <property name="header-suffix">
                  <object class="GtkMenuButton">
                    <property name="icon-name">dialog-question-symbolic</property>
                    <property name="popover">popover</property>
                    <property name="tooltip-text" translatable="yes">Help</property>
                    <style>
                      <class name="flat"/>
                    </style>
                  </object>
                </property>
                <child>
                  <object class="GtkScrolledWindow">
                    <property name="margin-bottom">24</property>
                    <property name="height-request">90</property>
                    <child>
                      <object class="GtkTextView" id="text_view">
                        <property name="hexpand">True</property>
                        <property name="monospace">True</property>
                        <property name="wrap-mode">word</property>
                        <style>
                          <class name="inline"/>
                        </style>
                        <accessibility>
                          <relation name="labelled-by">citation_fmt_group</relation>
                        </accessibility>
                      </object>
                    </child>
                    <style>
                      <class name="card"/>
                    </style>
                  </object>
                </child>
              </object>
            </child>
          </object>
        </child>
        <child>
          <object class="AdwPreferencesGroup" id="citation_group">
            <property name="title" translatable="yes">Citation</property>
            <property name="header-suffix">
              <object class="GtkBox">
                <property name="spacing">6</property>
                <child>
                  <object class="GtkDropDown" id="template_drop_down">
                    <property name="model">
                      <object class="GtkEnumList">
                        <property name="enum-type">Template</property>
                      </object>
                    </property>
                    <property name="expression">
                      <closure type="gchararray" function="template_type_name"/>
                    </property>
                    <accessibility>
                      <relation name="controls">source_view</relation>
                    </accessibility>
                  </object>
                </child>
                <child>
                  <object class="GtkDropDown" id="drop_down">
                    <property name="model">
                      <object class="GtkEnumList">
                        <property name="enum-type">Format</property>
                      </object>
                    </property>
                    <property name="expression">
                      <closure type="gchararray" function="format_type_name"/>
                    </property>
                    <accessibility>
                      <relation name="controls">source_view</relation>
                    </accessibility>
                  </object>
                </child>
              </object>
            </property>
            <child>
              <object class="GtkScrolledWindow">
                <property name="height-request">90</property>
                <child>
                  <object class="GtkOverlay">
                    <child type="overlay">
                      <object class="GtkButton">
                        <property name="halign">end</property>
                        <property name="valign">end</property>
                        <property name="icon-name">edit-copy-symbolic</property>
                        <property name="margin-end">6</property>
                        <property name="margin-start">6</property>
                        <property name="margin-top">6</property>
                        <property name="margin-bottom">6</property>
                        <property name="tooltip-text" translatable="yes">Copy</property>
                        <signal name="clicked" handler="on_clicked" swapped="true"/>
                        <style>
                          <class name="flat"/>
                        </style>
                      </object>
                    </child>
                    <child>
                      <object class="GtkSourceView" id="source_view">
                        <property name="hexpand">True</property>
                        <property name="wrap-mode">word</property>
                        <property name="editable">False</property>
                        <property name="accepts-tab">False</property>
                        <style>
                          <class name="inline"/>
                        </style>
                        <accessibility>
                          <relation name="labelled-by">citation_group</relation>
                        </accessibility>
                      </object>
                    </child>
                  </object>
                </child>
                <style>
                  <class name="card"/>
                </style>
              </object>
            </child>
          </object>
        </child>
      </object>
    </child>
  </template>
  <object class="GtkPopover" id="popover">
    <child>
      <object class="GtkBox">
        <property name="orientation">vertical</property>
        <property name="spacing">6</property>
        <property name="margin-start">6</property>
        <property name="margin-end">6</property>
        <property name="margin-top">6</property>
        <property name="margin-bottom">6</property>
        <child>
          <object class="GtkLabel">
            <property name="label" translatable="yes">Custom Template</property>
            <property name="xalign">0</property>
            <style>
              <class name="heading"/>
            </style>
          </object>
        </child>
        <child>
          <object class="GtkLabel">
            <property name="xalign">0</property>
            <property name="wrap">True</property>
            <property name="wrap-mode">word-char</property>
            <property name="ellipsize">none</property>
            <property name="lines">4</property>
            <property name="use-markup">True</property>
            <property name="max-width-chars">40</property>
            <property name="label" translatable="yes">Write a custom format for your citations, to insert the contents of a tag <tt>sometag</tt> write <tt>%SOMETAG%</tt>. Basic markdown syntax for bold and italics is supported. </property>
          </object>
        </child>
        <child>
          <object class="GtkLabel">
            <property name="label" translatable="yes">Example:</property>
            <property name="xalign">0</property>
            <style>
              <class name="heading"/>
            </style>
          </object>
        </child>
        <child>
          <object class="GtkScrolledWindow">
            <property name="height-request">70</property>
            <property name="width-request">300</property>
            <property name="max-content-width">300</property>
            <property name="hscrollbar-policy">never</property>
            <child>
              <object class="GtkTextView" id="help_source_view">
                <property name="hexpand">True</property>
                <property name="wrap-mode">word</property>
                <property name="editable">False</property>
                <property name="monospace">True</property>
                <style>
                  <class name="inline"/>
                </style>
              </object>
            </child>
            <style>
              <class name="card"/>
            </style>
          </object>
        </child>
      </object>
    </child>
  </object>
</interface>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<interface>
  <template class="EntryList" parent="AdwBin">
    <child>
      <object class="GtkStack" id="stack">
        <child>
          <object class="AdwStatusPage" id="empty_list">
            <property name="icon-name">document-text-symbolic</property>
            <property name="title" translatable="yes" comments="TRANSLATORS Empty state widget">No Citations</property>
            <property name="description" translatable="yes">Create a new citation</property>
            <style>
              <class name="compact"/>
            </style>
          </object>
        </child>
        <child>
          <object class="GtkScrolledWindow" id="scrolled_window">
            <property name="hscrollbar-policy">never</property>
            <child>
              <object class="GtkListView" id="list_view">
                <property name="single-click-activate">True</property>
                <signal name="activate" handler="on_list_activate" swapped="yes"/>
                <style>
                  <class name="navigation-sidebar"/>
                  <class name="padded-sidebar"/>
                </style>
              </object>
            </child>
          </object>
        </child>
      </object>
    </child>
  </template>
</interface>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<interface>
  <template class="EntryListRow">
    <child>
      <object class="GtkGestureClick" id="menu_gesture">
        <property name="button">0</property>
        <property name="exclusive">True</property>
        <signal name="pressed" handler="menu_gesture_pressed"/>
      </object>
    </child>
    <child>
      <object class="GtkGestureLongPress">
        <property name="delay-factor">2</property>
        <property name="touch-only">True</property>
        <property name="exclusive">True</property>
        <signal name="pressed" handler="menu_long_gesture_pressed"/>
      </object>
    </child>
    <child>
      <object class="GtkPopoverMenu" id="popover">
        <property name="menu-model">row_menu</property>
        <property name="has-arrow">False</property>
        <property name="halign">start</property>
        <property name="position">bottom</property>
      </object>
    </child>
    <child>
      <object class="GtkBox" id="child">
        <property name="margin-start">6</property>
        <property name="margin-end">6</property>
        <property name="margin-top">12</property>
        <property name="margin-bottom">12</property>
        <property name="orientation">vertical</property>
        <property name="spacing">6</property>
        <child>
          <object class="GtkBox">
            <property name="spacing">6</property>
            <child>
              <object class="GtkLabel" id="author">
                <property name="hexpand">True</property>
                <property name="xalign">0</property>
                <property name="ellipsize">end</property>
                <property name="lines">2</property>
                <property name="wrap">True</property>
                <property name="wrap-mode">word-char</property>
                <style>
                  <class name="title"/>
                </style>
              </object>
            </child>
            <child>
              <object class="GtkLabel" id="year_label">
                <property name="yalign">0</property>
                <style>
                  <class name="dimmed"/>
                  <class name="numeric"/>
                </style>
              </object>
            </child>
          </object>
        </child>
        <child>
          <object class="GtkLabel" id="title_label">
            <property name="ellipsize">end</property>
            <property name="lines">2</property>
            <property name="wrap">True</property>
            <property name="wrap-mode">word-char</property>
            <property name="xalign">0</property>
            <property name="hexpand">True</property>
            <style>
              <class name="subtitle"/>
            </style>
          </object>
        </child>
      </object>
    </child>
  </template>
  <menu id="row_menu">
    <section>
      <item>
        <attribute name="label" translatable="yes">_Open PDF</attribute>
        <attribute name="action">entry-row.open-pdf</attribute>
      </item>
      <item>
        <attribute name="label" translatable="yes">_Copy Key</attribute>
        <attribute name="action">entry-row.copy-key</attribute>
      </item>
    </section>
    <section>
      <item>
        <attribute name="label" translatable="yes">_Delete</attribute>
        <attribute name="action">entry-row.delete</attribute>
      </item>
    </section>
  </menu>
</interface>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<interface>
  <template class="EntryPage" parent="AdwBin">
    <child>
      <object class="GtkStack" id="stack">
        <child>
          <object class="AdwBin" id="empty_bin"/>
        </child>
        <child>
          <object class="AdwStatusPage" id="empty_page">
            <property name="vexpand">True</property>
            <property name="icon-name">document-text-symbolic</property>
            <property name="title" translatable="yes">No Citation Selected</property>
          </object>
        </child>
        <child>
          <object class="GtkScrolledWindow" id="non_empty_page">
            <property name="hscrollbar-policy">never</property>
            <property name="vexpand">True</property>
            <child>
              <object class="GtkViewport">
                <property name="vscroll-policy">natural</property>
                <child>
                  <object class="AdwClamp">
                    <property name="margin-start">12</property>
                    <property name="margin-end">12</property>
                    <property name="margin-top">36</property>
                    <property name="margin-bottom">36</property>
                    <child>
                      <object class="GtkBox">
                        <property name="orientation">vertical</property>
                        <property name="spacing">30</property>
                        <child>
                          <object class="GtkBox">
                            <property name="orientation">vertical</property>
                            <property name="spacing">12</property>
                            <child>
                              <object class="GtkBox">
                                <property name="spacing">6</property>
                                <child>
                                  <object class="GtkLabel" id="entry_type_label">
                                    <property name="hexpand">True</property>
                                    <property name="xalign">0</property>
                                    <property name="yalign">1</property>
                                    <property name="ellipsize">none</property>
                                    <style>
                                      <class name="title-1"/>
                                    </style>
                                  </object>
                                </child>
                                <child>
                                  <object class="GtkLabel" id="citation_label">
                                    <property name="yalign">1</property>
                                    <property name="ellipsize">end</property>
                                    <style>
                                      <class name="dimmed"/>
                                    </style>
                                  </object>
                                </child>
                              </object>
                            </child>
                            <child>
                              <object class="GtkListBox">
                                <property name="selection-mode">none</property>
                                <style>
                                  <class name="boxed-list"/>
                                </style>
                                <child>
                                  <object class="AdwComboRow" id="entry_type_combo_row">
                                    <property name="title" translatable="yes">Citation _Type</property>
                                    <property name="use-underline">True</property>
                                    <property name="model">
                                      <object class="GtkEnumList">
                                        <property name="enum-type">EntryType</property>
                                      </object>
                                    </property>
                                    <property name="expression">
                                      <closure type="gchararray" function="drop_down_entry_type_name"/>
                                    </property>
                                    <signal name="notify::selected" handler="on_entry_type_selected_notify" swapped="true"/>
                                  </object>
                                </child>
                                <child>
                                  <object class="AdwEntryRow" id="other_entry_type_row">
                                    <property name="visible">False</property>
                                    <property name="title" translatable="yes">_Other Citation Type</property>
                                    <property name="use-underline">True</property>
                                    <signal name="changed" handler="on_entry_type_entry_row_changed" swapped="true"/>
                                  </object>
                                </child>
                                <child>
                                  <object class="AdwEntryRow" id="citation_key_entry">
                                    <property name="title" translatable="yes">_Citation Key</property>
                                    <property name="use-underline">True</property>
                                    <property name="show-apply-button">True</property>
                                    <signal name="apply" handler="on_citation_key_apply"/>
                                    <child>
                                      <object class="GtkButton">
                                        <property name="valign">center</property>
                                        <property name="icon-name">edit-copy-symbolic</property>
                                        <property name="tooltip-text" translatable="yes">Copy</property>
                                        <signal name="clicked" handler="on_copy_key_clicked" swapped="true"/>
                                        <style>
                                          <class name="flat"/>
                                        </style>
                                      </object>
                                    </child>
                                  </object>
                                </child>
                                <child>
                                  <object class="AdwEntryRow" id="author_entry">
                                    <property name="title" translatable="yes">_Author</property>
                                    <property name="use-underline">True</property>
                                  </object>
                                </child>
                                <child>
                                  <object class="AdwEntryRow" id="title_entry">
                                    <property name="title" translatable="yes">_Title</property>
                                    <property name="use-underline">True</property>
                                  </object>
                                </child>
                                <child>
                                  <object class="AdwEntryRow" id="year_entry">
                                    <property name="title" translatable="yes">_Year</property>
                                    <property name="use-underline">True</property>
                                    <style>
                                      <class name="numeric"/>
                                    </style>
                                  </object>
                                </child>
                                <child>
                                  <object class="AdwEntryRow" id="doi_entry">
                                    <property name="title">_DOI</property>
                                    <property name="use-underline">True</property>
                                    <child>
                                      <object class="GtkButton" id="doi_button">
                                        <property name="sensitive">False</property>
                                        <property name="valign">center</property>
                                        <property name="icon-name">external-link-symbolic</property>
                                        <property name="tooltip-text" translatable="yes">Open in Browser</property>
                                        <signal name="clicked" handler="on_doi_clicked" swapped="true"/>
                                        <style>
                                          <class name="flat"/>
                                        </style>
                                      </object>
                                    </child>
                                  </object>
                                </child>
                              </object>
                            </child>
                          </object>
                        </child>
                        <child>
                          <object class="AdwPreferencesGroup" id="extras_box">
                            <property name="visible">False</property>
                            <property name="title" translatable="yes">Other Properties</property>
                            <child>
                              <object class="GtkListBox" id="extras_list_box">
                                <property name="selection-mode">none</property>
                                <style>
                                  <class name="boxed-list"/>
                                </style>
                              </object>
                            </child>
                          </object>
                        </child>
                        <child>
                          <object class="AdwPreferencesGroup" id="abstract_preferences_group">
                            <property name="visible">False</property>
                            <property name="title" translatable="yes">Abstract</property>
                            <property name="header-suffix">
                              <object class="GtkButton">
                                <property name="icon-name">edit-copy-symbolic</property>
                                <property name="tooltip-text" translatable="yes">Copy Abstract</property>
                                <signal name="clicked" handler="on_copy_abstract_clicked" swapped="yes"/>
                                <style>
                                  <class name="flat"/>
                                </style>
                              </object>
                            </property>
                            <child>
                              <object class="GtkScrolledWindow">
                                <property name="height-request">180</property>
                                <child>
                                  <object class="GtkTextView" id="abstract_text_view">
                                    <property name="hexpand">True</property>
                                    <property name="wrap-mode">word</property>
                                    <property name="accepts-tab">False</property>
                                    <style>
                                      <class name="inline"/>
                                    </style>
                                    <accessibility>
                                      <relation name="labelled-by">abstract_preferences_group</relation>
                                    </accessibility>
                                  </object>
                                </child>
                                <style>
                                  <class name="card"/>
                                </style>
                              </object>
                            </child>
                          </object>
                        </child>
                        <child>
                          <object class="AdwPreferencesGroup" id="notes_preferences_group">
                            <property name="visible">False</property>
                            <property name="title" translatable="yes">Notes</property>
                            <property name="header-suffix">
                              <object class="GtkButton">
                                <property name="icon-name">edit-copy-symbolic</property>
                                <property name="tooltip-text" translatable="yes">Copy Notes</property>
                                <signal name="clicked" handler="on_copy_notes_clicked" swapped="yes"/>
                                <style>
                                  <class name="flat"/>
                                </style>
                              </object>
                            </property>
                            <child>
                              <object class="GtkScrolledWindow">
                                <property name="height-request">180</property>
                                <child>
                                  <object class="GtkTextView" id="notes_text_view">
                                    <property name="hexpand">True</property>
                                    <property name="wrap-mode">word</property>
                                    <property name="accepts-tab">False</property>
                                    <style>
                                      <class name="inline"/>
                                    </style>
                                    <accessibility>
                                      <relation name="labelled-by">notes_preferences_group</relation>
                                    </accessibility>
                                  </object>
                                </child>
                                <style>
                                  <class name="card"/>
                                </style>
                              </object>
                            </child>
                          </object>
                        </child>
                        <child>
                          <object class="CitationPreview">
                            <property name="entry" bind-source="EntryPage" bind-property="entry" bind-flags="sync-create"/>
                          </object>
                        </child>
                        <child>
                          <object class="GtkStack" id="pdf_stack">
                            <property name="transition-type">crossfade</property>
                            <property name="vhomogeneous">False</property>
                            <child>
                              <object class="GtkListBox" id="pdf_add_list_box">
                                <property name="selection-mode">none</property>
                                <property name="valign">start</property>
                                <child>
                                  <object class="AdwActionRow" id="set_pdf_expander_row">
                                    <property name="title" translatable="yes" comments="Translators: Selects a PDF file for the citation">Add PDF</property>
                                    <property name="activatable">True</property>
                                    <property name="action-name">entry-page.set-pdf</property>
                                    <child>
                                      <object class="GtkImage">
